The physical parameters should be set to an electric field strength of 6 V/m, an electron density of 5e19 m^-3, and a temperature of 100 eV. The code should also set up the radial grid, solver type, and time stepper. The output should be saved to an HDF5 file named 'output.h5'.

```python
import DREAM.Settings.Equilibrium as Equilibrium
import DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid as RadialGrid
import DREAM.Settings.Equations as Equations
import DREAM.Settings.Solver as Solver
import DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper as TimeStepper
import DREAM.Settings.EquationSystem as EquationSystem
import DREAM.Settings.Output as Output
import DREAM.Settings as Settings
import DREAM
import numpy as np

# Create DREAM settings object
ds = Settings.DREAMSettings()

# Set up radial grid (single zone)
ds.radialgrid.setNr(1)
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(1.0)   # [m]
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(1.1)    # [m]
ds.radialgrid.setMajorRadius(3.0)   # [m]

# Set constant temperature [eV]
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setPrescribedData(100)

# Set constant electron density [m^-3]
ds.eqsys.n_cold.setPrescribedData(5e19)

# Set constant electric field [V/m]
ds.eqsys.E_field.setPrescribedData(6)

# Set up momentum grid
me_c = 0.510998950e6 / 511e3  # m_e*c in units of m_e*c (so = 1)
ds.hottailgrid.setNxi(20)
ds.hottailgrid.setNp(300)
ds.hottailgrid.setPmax(1.0)  # [m_e*c]

ds.runawaygrid.setNxi(20)
ds.runawaygrid.setNp(300)
ds.runawaygrid.setPmax(1.0)  # [m_e*c]

# Set simulation time and time steps
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(20)

# Set solver type (linear)
ds.solver.setType(Solver.Solver.LINEAR)

# Set time stepper (constant step)
ds.timestep.setType(TimeStepper.TimeStepper.CONSTANT)

# Save output to file
ds.output.setFilename('output.h5')

# Run simulation
DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output.h5')
```
